7342.title: ACP translation drops nested output ownership
7342.rootCauseOneLine: ACP translation discards nested owner metadata and uses root stream keys for child text and tool activity.
7342.proposedFix: Preserve validated owner keys across tool lifecycles and isolate and flush nested text streams per owner.
7342.caveats: Deterministic translator/assembler reproduction, repeated by the same agent; no live external provider or UI session. The complete regression patch is inline in the report.
